title: Module 10 Quiz
description: Test your understanding of list methods, membership, slicing, safe copying, and choosing the correct list operation across all lessons in Module 10.

questions.prompt_text: Which method removes and returns the last item by default?
questions.explanation: pop() removes and returns an item; without an index it uses the last item.
